svg.aria-label: Budlum Leaf plate P08 energy architecture
svg.title: BUDLUM LEAF · P08 · ENERGY ARCHITECTURE
svg.text: BUDLUM LEAF · P08 · THE ENERGY ARCHITECTURE
The compute left the device. The energy did not have to leave with it. The cell spreads into the panel, and the sandwich stops being necessary.
A · THE BODIES · thickness to scale, 1 mm = 55 px
1.20 mm · 20 g · no cell · works on power
1.62 mm · 37 g · 2.6 Wh · 1.0 h at the base case
2.02 mm · 46 g · 5.5 Wh · 2.2 h at the base case
2.84 mm · 67 g · 14.0 Wh · 5.5 h at the base case
3.30 mm · 79 g · 20.1 Wh · 7.9 h at the base case
3.90 mm · 78 g · 20 Wh · 7.9 h · the reference

g.text: the Leaf 160 baseline is the 2.20 mm (72 g = 4 x 18 g) 4-Quadrant (+) Screen-Battery Body (12.0 Wh LLZO)
four 0.45 mm polymer-gel layers slide on three 0.05 mm silicone interlayers (0.38% strain at R 25.5 mm)
sheet 100 is 1.9 mm thinner than today and still carries half a working day

svg.text: B · ONE FACE WITH THE SHEET · layer by layer

g.text: scratch and the strain limit of the cover
low modulus, bend rated, the neutral axis tool
metal mesh, no indium tin oxide in a bend
the emissive stack and the encapsulation
polyimide with the 144 Hz copper row line

svg.text: the cell at the neutral axis, 110 cm²

g.text: the face above the sheet is 0.43 mm; the sheet sits at the center of the 4.00 mm prism
the sheet uses 4 continuous 0.45 mm layers separated by 0.05 mm silicone slip layers
all 4 layers run continuously across 72.0 x 152.0 mm with zero rigid tiles or cutouts
the carrier includes a 0.15 mm flexing graphite-copper heat spreader across 109.4 cm²

svg.text: C · THE FILLS · what each thickness buys · a Leaf 160

g.text: each 40 x 80 x 2.20 mm polycarbonate quadrant houses a 3.0 Wh LLZO solid-state cell + Qi2 coil (12.0 Wh total)
the same 20 Wh needs 22.2 cm³: as a cassette 2.88 mm, as a sheet 1.82 mm
the module adds 20 Wh and pairs with any fill; a Bare Leaf with the module runs 7.9 h
the cassette keeps the removable answer if the slip lip of gate ENR-8 fails
every value here is a hypothesis until ENR-7 and ENR-8 run on samples

svg.text: D · WHY A CELL EXISTS · the bill that cannot move off the device

g.text: the light · the panel is the product, the photons are made in the hand
the hub · the decoder, the local renderer and the reprojection unit
the radio · the link is the product, the bytes cross the air here
the authority · the wallet must answer with no network
the compute · it is at the validator, and the voice is a fixed function chip
a carried surface of 2026 spends 2 to 5 W on its own silicon; a Leaf spends 0.70 W
harvesting: indoor light is 10 to 100 µW/cm²: 2.5 to 25 mW over 256 cm²
against a 2 000 mW need that is 80 to 800 times short, so no surface lives on light
therefore a cell exists. the open question was only how thick, and where
the answer of this sheet: spread it, put it where the strain is zero, thin the body
and let the module and the hub carry the rest of the energy

svg.text: E · THE TWO WAYS TO BUY, THE TWO LEGAL ROUTES, AND WHAT MUST BE MEASURED

g.text: LEAF SCREEN · the surface, the sheet, the wallet
LEAF HUB · a separate hardware unit: 40 to 100 Wh, the ports,
the sound, the near services, the validator board as an option
LEAF MODULE · the camera, the sound set, the pen dock, 20 Wh
a user buys a screen; an operator buys a hub and earns
pay as you go: the effort tier in ms and the bytes of the class
A · the slip sheet: a 0.4 mm lip, 300 cycles, no tool
it keeps the European removability answer for 0.06 mm
B · the sealed sheet: thinner, and it needs a written opinion
per market before it may ship. the real energy source being
the validator does not change the law about the cell inside
the recommendation is A; B is a market variant, gated
ENR-7 the sheet energy · ENR-8 the slip cycles and the seal
MEC-15 the thin body · MEC-16 the sheet at the neutral axis
MEC-17 the charge heat · MEC-18 the mass · PRG-12 the law
the claim waits for the gates, and the gates wait for a cell partner

svg.text: The compute left the device; the energy did not have to leave with it. The cell spreads, the sandwich stops, and the middle of the body is free.
A review with a recommendation, D-8, and not a settled decision. Nothing on this sheet is a claim until ENR-7, ENR-8, MEC-16 and PRG-12 have raw data.
